raw.rationale: This is a glucocorticoid receptor agonist with diuretic SLC12A1/2 activity, and at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to show lineage-selective killing; glucocorticoids more often cause modest growth inhibition or resistance rather than selective cytotoxicity, and PRISM single-concentration screens rarely identify selective lineages for such agents. Any apparent selectivity would most plausibly reflect lymphoid-lineage GR dependence, but no lymphoid lineages are listed, so probabilities remain near the low base rate across all listed lineages.
